notes.title: Breaking News
notes.content:
Our plans for game release in July have been slightly overset. 
Between the release of the second and the third DLC for XXX Puzzle we were to release Mojo. Unfortunately, Mojo release is several weeks behind schedule. This is why the release of the remaining DLCs is postponed until August.

Our plans are as follows: 
- Release of Expansion Pack 3 – August 10.
- Release of Expansion Pack 4 – August 17 or 24.
